The current description of ASVS 4.0 - 1.14.2 is
```
Verify that if deploying binaries to untrusted devices makes use of binary signatures, trusted connections, and verified endpoints.
```

However, the [CWE 494](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/494.html) description is
```
Download of Code Without Integrity Check
The product downloads source code or an executable from a remote location and executes the code without sufficiently verifying the origin and integrity of the code. 
```

I think it would be more accurate to replace "untrusted device" with "remote device" since CWE's description focuses on the security of the owner of the device that runs the code.

I propose the new description as follows:
```
Verify integrity of binaries when deploying to remote devices by using binary signatures, trusted connections, and verified endpoints.
```

What's your opinion on this?
